text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PDR-4721 fired — latency SLO (p99) breach in eu-west. rule: slo.latency.p99 >= 2500ms for 5m. paging oncall-eng. runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/latency-p99
ana (oncall): acked PDR-4721 :raised_hand: I'm taking triage. starting quick checks.
devon: seeing p99 spike ~2.7s, p95 also creeping. any deploys in last 20m?
maria: no deploys. telemetry: high KV miss rate for model-cache in eu-west; big tail from a single customer job (gc-analytics-1).
ana (oncall): scaling dedicated-eu pool +2 GPUs, and enabling fallback routing for low-priority routes. run: `redwoodctl scale pool dedicated-eu --add 2`
incident-bot: k8s: new pod dedicated-eu-02 provisioning, pods: 5->7.
maria: routing change queued — will shift non-SLA traffic to fallback model `gpt-fast-128q` (lower perf but faster).
ana (oncall): applying canary reroute for 10% of traffic:
```
redwoodctl route update --region eu-west --selector lowpri --fallback gpt-fast-128q --weight 10
```
sre-lead: any immediate customer impact? need to know if status page required.
devon: quick check — 3 distinct customer errors on embedding endpoint, small set, not widespread yet.
maria: KV cache warmup started. cache hit rate rising from 15% -> 60% over last 30s.
ana (oncall): marked incident Sev3 for now. ETA for scale + warm caches ~90s :hourglass_flowing_sand:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PDR-4721 acknowledged by ana (oncall).
pm-ralph: flagging customer comms — if impact grows I'll prepare a 1-line status.
maria: p99 improved 2700ms -> 1600ms in last 45s after scale + fallback. p95 ~120ms.
ana (oncall): continuing to monitor 10m window. if stable we'll resolve PD and file follow-up. :thumbsup:
devon: noted large batch from gc-analytics-1; adding to follow-up for rate-limiting and routing safeguards.
maria: p99 now ~900ms, p95 steady. cache hit ~85%. mitigation looks effective.
ana (oncall): closing the active remediation loop, will keep watch for 10m then resolve. handing off postmortem owners: @maria for root-cause, @devon for routing playbook edits.
ana (oncall): handoff to next oncall in 30m for monitoring window.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PDR-4721 resolved by ana (oncall) at ts=3159999130.
